phase3_findings.description: The reworded #810 comment calls the consuming gate 'the production pin-corpus-lint.py whole-tree scan in run.sh'. The #810 machinery it describes is consumed by run.sh:31195 `pin-corpus-lint.py mutation-routing-worktree`, whose scan_worktree runs two subgates over the closed 13-entry AUDITED_PIN_SOURCES registry plus lib/test/test_*.py leaves, diffed against origin/main — registry-closed and diff-scoped, not whole-tree. run.sh also carries `lint` and `wrapped` subcommands, so the phrase had no unique referent.

The new raw text-presence assertion falls under the repo's wording-only pin policy and carries no `# structural-pin-ok:` declaration; also flagged as guard-class shape 4 (re-derived consumer contract) and shape 3 (no positive control).

The `|| true` collapses grep rc 1 (benign no-match), rc 2 (missing/unreadable) and rc 127 (grep absent) into one indistinguishable success; the fail-closed property rests on grep's stdout-silence-on-error and is nowhere documented, so an -s flag or a second operand would silently invert it.
The comment and assertion name say 'invocation' but the guard is presence-based: any mention of the basename in run.sh, including a bare comment reference, trips it.
'a second serial execution' carries an exact ordinal, the class CLAUDE.md flags as rot-prone: a third execution channel would silently falsify it.
The accepted residual (a reintroduced invocation in another lib/test/modules/*.sh or in lib/test/module-harness.sh) is recorded only in the issue, not beside the assertion.
The new assertion presents no positive control / mutation evidence; cheapest discharge is stating the observed RED in the PR description.

MODULE_DRIVEN_SUITES has no call-site enforcement: nothing asserts a member is absent from run.sh's invocation set, which is how the #865 duplication survived. A generic cross-check in test_module_runner.py would subsume both the #798 and #810 greps for all eleven module-driven suites.

fix_decisions.claim_text: the new raw text-presence assertion is a prohibited wording-only pin and needs a # structural-pin-ok: declaration
fix_decisions.evidence: Refuted by executable evidence on three independent channels: (1) the #810 extractor builds a guard site only for a raw grep carrying BOTH -F and -q (_raw_options_are_fixed_quiet) and exempts count-based guards by helper (COUNT_HELPERS); this assertion is -cF, so extract_guard_sites() returns zero sites for the file — the requesting-code-review reviewer confirmed this by running the real extractor in-process. (2) The full suite, which runs the #810 mutation-routing-worktree gate over AUDITED_PIN_SOURCES (harness-python-guards.sh included), is GREEN. (3) The literal is not wording-only under the policy's own definition: `test_pin_corpus_lint.py` cannot change without the module's own invocation at :321 changing with it, so it cannot change without changing executable behavior. The pre-existing #798 sibling the AC mandates mirroring carries no declaration either.
